title: mut.diversify_object_pool

If the parent uses ANY 3D-model loader (PLYLoader / GLTFLoader / OBJLoader), you MUST swap the loaded object to the URL below — and you MUST NOT pick Lucy or LeePerrySmith again. Pick whichever URL has a connotation MOST DIFFERENT from what the parent's lineage has shown so far.
